scope_rules: Default scope is 'submission' for every parameter FDA-SW Table 1, FDA-OTS III, FDA-CY V-VII or FDA-STD IV.A(1)-(2) names; 'dhf' (design and development file / QMS record, ISO 13485:2016 7.3.10 via 21 CFR 820.10) for parameters whose only source is a retention clause (IEC 62304 5.6.7 b), 5.7.5 b), 5.1.10, 8.2) or an FDA 'via the DHF ... FDA may request' sentence (FDA-SW VI.F Basic, FDA-OTS III.D Basic, FDA-STD IV.A).
A missing 'dhf'-scope parameter is reported as 'not in submission; available on request' and lowers confidence; it never lowers completeness.

Build-identity fallback: when the sponsor uses no build-id scheme, the version string satisfies release_build_id, build_id_under_test, build_tested, list_build_id and described_build_id, with a confidence qualifier 'build identity by version only'.

l2_additions.title: IEC 62304 software safety classification and rationale
l2_additions.expectation: Each software system (and, where decomposed, each software item) carries a software safety class A, B or C assigned from the worst-case severity of the hazardous situation it can contribute to, with the 100 percent failure-probability assumption, any reduction via hardware risk controls, and segregation claims used for item-level classification. The class is distinct from the FDA Documentation Level and decides which IEC 62304 clauses a DoC can claim.

clauses.loc: V (Documentation Level is not the 62304 class)

parameters.name: software_system_id
parameters.check: must exist in architecture (L2-06.01) or equal the module software system

parameters.name: safety_class
parameters.check: A|B|C; Enhanced Documentation Level with class A is a contradiction to query (CC-28)

parameters.name: worst_case_hazardous_situation_ids
parameters.check: each must exist in L2-04.03; severity must support the class (C = death or serious injury)

parameters.name: hardware_risk_controls_relied_on
parameters.check: if class reduced from C to B or B to A, each control must exist in L2-04.05 with control_type not 'information for safety' and be external to the software system

parameters.name: item_level_classes_and_segregation
parameters.check: each segregated item must appear in L2-06.02 with a segregation_claim and a verification reference (62304 5.3.5)

l2_additions.title: Legacy software rationale (IEC 62304 4.4)
l2_additions.expectation: When the sponsor invokes 4.4 for software developed before 62304 was applied: post-production feedback assessed, risk management of continued use performed, gap analysis of deliverables against 5.2, 5.3, 5.7 and clause 7 with the minimum deliverable being system test records (5.7.5), a gap-closure plan executed, and the rationale for continued use documented in the risk management file.

parameters.name: legacy_item_ids
parameters.check: each must exist in L2-06.02 / L2-03.03 (conditional: only when 4.4 is invoked)

parameters.name: system_test_records_present
parameters.check: must be true (4.4.3 c) minimum deliverable; records per 5.7.5 in L2-09.05)

parameters.name: rationale_in_rmf
parameters.check: 4.4.5: rationale recorded in the risk management file (L1-04)

l2_additions.title: Safety traceability matrix document (hazard - requirement - design - test)
l2_additions.expectation: Where the HAZ -> SRS/SDS -> UT/INT/SYS trace is presented as a separate document (FDA-SW VI.C(2)), the document is identified with version, export date and the software version it covers, and its rows reconcile with the per-artifact links captured in L2-04.05, L2-05.02, L2-07.01 and L2-09.02.

clauses.loc: VI.C(2) Risk Control Measures (traceability; separate document permitted)

parameters.name: document_id
parameters.check: optional document; when absent the trace must still be recoverable from L2-04.05 links

parameters.name: matrix_version_and_export_date
parameters.check: export date must be on/after the risk report date minus the tolerance set for the case and on/before A.module_submission_date

parameters.name: rows_reconcile_with_artifacts
parameters.check: set comparison against L2-04.05.implementing_requirement_ids / implementation_verification_test_ids (CC-02); any left-only or right-only row is a finding

parameters.name: untraced_hazards
parameters.check: must be empty or each justified (ISO 14971 4.5)

l2_merges.note: v3 collapse for the first synthetic test: one L2 'Security controls by category' with parameter category (enum: authentication|authorization|cryptography|code_data_execution_integrity|confidentiality|event_detection_logging|resiliency_recovery|updatability_patchability (Appendix 1 heading: Firmware and Software Updates)), plus control_id, security_requirement_ids, implementation_ref, verification_test_ids, applies_to_assets_interfaces, not_applicable_rationale. Category-specific parameters (algorithms, key management, roles, log protection, rollback behaviour) return when L1-21 is expanded. CC-04 keeps the S3 'implemented and tested for effectiveness' test (FDA-CY V.B.1). Keep L2-21.09 separate.

Integration information (FDA-CY VI.A bullets 1-4): recommended controls, user diagrams, port/interface list, infrastructure and incident response. Keep port_or_interface, direction, approved_endpoints as named parameters because CC-15 joins on them; add coverage enum for bullets 1, 2, 4.

Software identity and lifecycle (VI.A bullets 5, 6, 13, 14 and the MDS2 paragraph): SBOM availability and labeled SBOM version (CC-05), download/update procedure, device and component end of support with risk-transfer process (CC-14), decommissioning; MDS2 as optional vehicle.

Operational security information (VI.A bullets 7-12): event response and notification, logging/forensics, critical-function protection, backup/restore, configuration recovery, secure shipped configuration and risk-increasing user changes; one coverage enum plus free-text refs. L2-24.12 (transferred risks as HF tasks) stays separate because it joins L1-27 (CC-16).
Monitoring and identification: personnel, sources/methods/frequency incl. KEV handling, periodic security testing (FDA-CY VI.B bullets 1-4).

Remediation and delivery: regular-cycle and out-of-cycle timelines with justification (524B(b)(2)(A)-(B); FDA-CY VII.C.1 'second', fn 65), update process, patching capability rate, customer communication, support horizon (A.device_support_end), fielded-version differences (VII.C.1 'third').

CVD and vulnerability handling: CVD policy and intake (VI.B bullet 8; VII.C.1 'first'; 524B(b)(1)), handling phases (ISO/IEC 30111 7.1.2-7.1.7, IEC 81001-5-1 9.2-9.5; TIR97 Annex C). Record the declared standard edition: the library 29147:2018 and 30111:2019 are not the recognized editions (13-77 is 2014; 13-78 is 2013).

chain_additions.title: Security acceptance threshold vs residual scores
chain_additions.condition: For every L2-15.02 entry, post_mitigation_score above L2-15.01.acceptance_threshold implies the vulnerability_id is in L2-15.04.residual_unacceptable_ids with a benefit-risk reference, and L2-15.04.overall_conclusion is consistent (no 'acceptable' conclusion with unaccepted residuals). Scoring_system_and_version must be one the SIS accepts (CVSS v4.0 13-140; v3.1 13-142 until 2028-07-02; v3.0 13-116 until 2026-12-20).

chain_additions.title: Unresolved anomaly to risk file closure
chain_additions.condition: Every L2-11.01.risk_file_link resolves to a hazardous_situation in L2-04.03; that situation's L2-04.06.open_anomaly_ids_affecting lists the anomaly; safety_effectiveness_impact uses the plan severity scale; anomalies with security_impact_assessed=true appear in L2-18.01 (when active) or carry the assessment inline.
chain_additions.severity: S2; S3 when the linked hazardous situation is death or serious injury

chain_additions.title: Software safety class vs Documentation Level vs DoC clause applicability
chain_additions.condition: L2-01.02.safety_class = A with A.documentation_level = Enhanced is a contradiction to query (62304 4.3 class A: no injury possible; FDA-SW V Enhanced: death or serious injury possible before controls). Clauses claimed in a 62304 DoC (L2-28.03.clauses_claimed) must be applicable to the assigned class (e.g., 5.8.5 is Class B, C; 5.3.5 is Class C; 5.5.2-5.5.5 are B/C or C).
